rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday adjective for something a long distance away; use 好遠嘅 before a noun.

example.english: That restaurant is faraway, so let’s take the bus.
example.traditional: 嗰間餐廳好遠，我哋搭巴士去啦。
example.jyutping: go2 gaan1 caan1 teng1 hou2 jyun5 ngo5 dei6 daap3 baa1 si6 heoi3 laa1
